scope: Recover total filter-channel images from one spatially overlapped common-FOV frame
evidence_level: synthetic engineering simulation, hypothetical calibrated optics and camera

channels.label: CH-region
channels.purpose: total transmitted image, not isolated CH concentration

channels.label: AlO-region
channels.purpose: total transmitted image, not isolated AlO concentration

channels.label: C2-region
channels.purpose: total transmitted image, not isolated C2 concentration

optional_extension.label: OH-region
optional_extension.requires: verified UV optics, filter transmission and sensor response

source_evidence.supports: Experimental 310, 431.5 and 516.5 nm filters, each 10 nm FWHM; ICCD setup does not validate our CMOS speed or throughput
Observed AlO band near 486 nm; tabulated 484.2/486.6 nm features; 513 nm region contains overlapping AlO/C2 emission

unknown_hardware: physical pixel size and field of view

model.boundary: periodic finite grid for the primary matched model
model.target: post-object-optics band image before the spatial carrier, in expected electrons at unit gain
model.sensor_model: independent Poisson counts, Gaussian read noise, then ADC with black offset and saturation

design.independent_maps: Each channel has its own synthetic morphology and random seed. No shared spectral/chemical/temperature parameterization.
design.primary_operating_point: balanced channels, each mean 4000 electrons before modulation
stress_cases: decoder phase calibration +2 degrees in each channel
decoder channel gain +5 percent in each channel
design.saved_observations: All primary noisy raw frames as lossless uint16 ADC values; all unit-radiance and target maps; selected reconstructions; complete per-frame metrics and seeds

predeclared_success.purpose: engineering screen for this bounded simulated baseline, not hardware acceptance

metric_definitions.relative_L2: norm(decoded-target)/norm(target), all 65536 pixels, each channel separately
metric_definitions.leakage_L2_ratio: norm(inactive decoded channel)/norm(active target channel), noiseless single-active-channel input
metric_definitions.optical_detail_loss_relative_L2: norm(post-object-optics image-pre-optics image)/norm(pre-optics image), reported separately
